Item identities (ETag, size, date) and the transfer are recorded; no credential material is.

Pinned Laserdata Skog inventory: the active 26f015-702_68 (one June 2026 ALS campaign, 3.119 returns/m2, exclusive over the whole 15.56 km2 AOI, zero seams) and the superseded 2020 item 20f015-702_68 at 0 km2 exclusive. record-laser-campaigns --check re-derives the live catalogue and fails on drift.

Bunkers (sand in the z18 orthoimagery over a dish in the published 1 m laser terrain), ditches crossing the playing lines and flat tee decks, derived 2026-09-05 by geobuild/derive-dtm-features.mjs; replaces the plan readings and guide placements on holes 1-5, 7, 13, 15 and 18.
The club's Lokala regler och tävlingsvillkor 2025, transcribed: out-of-bounds per hole, red-only penalty areas, bridges, drainage ditches. reconcile.mjs derives the white marking from it.

The fjärd's shoreline and every pond's outline read off the flat water plates in the published 1 m laser terrain (0.280 m RH 2000 for the lake), traced at 2 m near the course and spliced onto the OSM ring on the DTM window's edge; derived 2026-09-05 by geobuild/laser-water.mjs, adopted by reconcile.mjs as prov 'laser'.
